summary: RDS Multi-Output Feature - All 24 backend tests passed, frontend UI fully functional. Feature allows creating multiple RDS outputs per station (Streaming, DAB+, FM) with configurable items and durations.
critical_code_review_comments: Code implementation is clean and follows FastAPI best practices
Public endpoints return empty string for non-existent outputs (graceful degradation)
Slug validation ensures URL-safe identifiers (lowercase, alphanumeric, hyphens only)
Duplicate slug detection prevents conflicts within same station
Scheduler correctly processes all enabled outputs every second
seed_data_creation: Test data created/cleaned up within test fixtures. Existing GRK outputs: streaming, dab, fm
context_for_next_testing_agent: RDS Multi-Output feature is fully implemented and working. GRK station has 3 outputs configured: streaming (show_name + now_playing), dab (show_name only), fm (custom_text only). Public endpoints: /api/rds-builder/output/{station}/{slug}.txt return current rotated text based on item durations.

GET /api/rds-builder/outputs/{station}.details: Returns list of outputs for station with current_text included

POST /api/rds-builder/outputs/{station}.details: Creates new output with items, validates slug format, detects duplicates

PUT /api/rds-builder/outputs/{station}/{.details: Updates output configuration, returns 404 for non-existent

DELETE /api/rds-builder/outputs/{station.details: Deletes output and its state, verified removal

GET /api/rds-builder/output/{station}/{s.details: Public endpoint returns plain text, rotates based on items/durations

GET /api/rds-builder/outputs/{station}/{.details: Returns current state with index, item type, next change time

Output Rotation.details: Scheduler processes outputs every second, different outputs show different text

Frontend Multi-Output Tab.details: Shows output cards for MFY and GRK with current text, edit/delete buttons, URL copy

Frontend Create Dialog.details: Name, slug fields, item toggles with durations, output active/loop toggles

Frontend Edit Dialog.details: Slug field disabled, pre-populated with existing values

Frontend Legacy Tab.details: Sequence builder for both stations, item add/remove, reorder functionality
